vectors.name: runt_17_bytes
vectors.note: 17 bytes cannot hold a 16-byte header plus a CRC16. The CRC over the truncated buffer is valid, so only the length can catch it.

vectors.name: oversize_223_bytes
vectors.note: Emitting this is a sender bug; receiving it is a counted runtime discard, never an assertion (§3).

vectors.name: bad_app_crc16
vectors.note: High CRC byte inverted. This is the one vector whose CRC is deliberately NOT repaired.

vectors.name: unknown_ver_3
vectors.note: A node accepts only its own ver; only the bridge accepts N-1 (§13.1). CRC repaired.

vectors.name: wrong_dst_not_addressed
vectors.note: Addressed to WellLink. Discarded silently by GateLink - no ERROR reply is owed (§14).

vectors.name: critical_ext_unimplemented
vectors.note: No extension is defined yet (W8), so every receiver must discard loudly with ERROR(UNKNOWN_HDR_EXT).

vectors.name: frag_total_zero
vectors.note: 0x00 is a malformed header, NOT a single-frame marker; 0x01 is the single-frame value.

vectors.name: frag_index_ge_total
vectors.note: index 3 of total 1. AMBIGUITY: §11.2 calls index >= total FRAGMENT_OVERFLOW at stage 10, but §14 stage 5b tests index < total and runs first. Taken at 5b.

vectors.name: frag_index_equals_total
vectors.note: A 0-based index equal to the 1-based total is the off-by-one an encoder actually makes.

vectors.name: unknown_type_0x0c
vectors.note: Adding a type needs no ver bump precisely because this discard exists (§13.2).

vectors.name: status_carrying_event_schema
vectors.note: Schema 0x11 is well known but is an EVENT schema. The (type, schema) PAIR is the unit of validation, so this fails at 7, not 8.

vectors.name: unknown_schema_0x99
vectors.note: 0x99 is unassigned in §7.1 and §17.2.

vectors.name: poll_payload_two_bytes
vectors.note: POLL is fixed at 1 byte (§6.4). A length mismatch is discarded, never parsed best-effort.

vectors.name: status_0x10_76_bytes
vectors.note: 76 bytes is v0.2's status length. Schema 0x10 is 78 B in v0.3+ (§7.2.9), so the old size must be rejected, not truncated-parsed.

vectors.name: fragmented_hex_req
vectors.note: HEX_REQ is single-frame in v1: `n` lives only in fragment 0 and the MAC requirement depends on a nibble inside the payload (§11.4). ERROR(BAD_LENGTH).

vectors.name: fragmented_command
vectors.note: A 4-byte COMMAND is never fragmentable. The MAC is valid, so stage 8a must reject it before stage 9 accepts it.

vectors.name: command_ctx_mismatch
vectors.note: MAC is valid over this header, so only the ctx check can fail: the node replies COMMAND_ACK(REJECTED_CTX) carrying its own ctx_id.

vectors.name: command_corrupt_mac
vectors.note: One MAC byte inverted, CRC repaired. Verification must be constant time (§9.4).

vectors.name: command_signed_with_wrong_node_key
vectors.note: Signed with simnode-0's key but addressed to GateLink. This is the property §5.3 relies on: a bench node cannot forge a HOLD_OPEN to the gate.

vectors.name: command_with_no_mac
vectors.note: An authenticated type with the MAC omitted is 8 bytes short, so the length check catches it first. §9.2 forbids ever emitting one.
